name: Powerful Stench
body:
You have greater control over your odor glands than most taers.

Prerequisite(s): Stench trait, taer.

Benefit(s): The range of your stench aura extends to 15 feet. In addition, you can use that ability an additional number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), although you must wait 1d4 rounds between uses.
